_description: Ability passports (docs/en/training/model.md, abilities): what each ability of our units does, from the game's database. Written by py -3.14 -m tools.nn.abilities.

_fields.active_s: unit_special_abilities.active_time, s; -1: no duration (passive or instant)
_fields.initial_s: unit_special_abilities.initial_recharge, s: the ability is on cooldown this long from the battle's start (-1 and 0: ready at once; Steam guide 1698960734 'most abilities start at 0'; Gate of Khorne 60 = fandom)
_fields.vigour_per_s: special_ability_phases.fatigue_change_ratio of the ability's phases (-0.01 for Foe-Seeker = fandom 'Vigour per second: -1%'): the share of the maximum fatigue (30000) the owner loses each second while it is active (negative: recovers; the in-game probe build/movelords: -300 points/s)
_fields.range_m: unit_special_abilities.effect_range, m: the reach around the caster (0: itself)
_fields.passive: active_s and recharge_s both -1 (ours; the table's own passive column also marks Strength of the Penitent, our auto); checked against the cards' owned_passive lists
_fields.targets_own: unit_special_abilities.affect_self: the ability acts on its caster too
_fields.update_targets: unit_special_abilities.update_targets_every_frame: 1 - the ability picks its targets in range every frame, an aura that follows the caster (Rally, Hold the Line); 0 - it is laid once at the cast on the units in range, and they keep it for active_s wherever they go, later arrivals get nothing (Stand Your Ground; 142 recorded battles, build/effects/spec.md 3.2)
_fields.self_cast: active, not auto, affect_self, friendly_units and enemy_units 0 or -1 (ours): used on the caster himself, no target to choose (perform_special_ability(key, the lord))
_fields.recharge_when: special_ability_to_recharge_contexts.recharge_context of the ability: its recharge runs only while this holds (Strength of the Penitent: losing_melee_combat - 3 s while losing, CA hotfix 6.2.2; as the game acts on it: while not winning its melee, out of melee too - build/effectsimpl; Wounds: health_below_25% - its 5 s initial recharge runs once below a quarter); a passive without an active time is on only once it has recharged so
_fields.off_when: special_ability_to_auto_deactivate_flags.deactivate_flag: the effect switches off while this holds (Frenzy: morale_is_lower_than_half_of_base_morale; Penitent: out_of_melee)
_fields.auto: a timed passive (ours): an active time, a key with '_passive_' (the game lists it among the passives, unit_abilities) - the game fires it by itself whenever it is ready and nothing holds it off (off_when; the recordings: Strength of the Penitent on at the contact, 53 of 54, without losses too); no player or network order
_fields.phases: special_ability_to_special_ability_phase_junctions for the ability: the phase named as the ability when there is one, else all its phases
_fields.targets: the phases' target_self / target_friends / target_enemies (self-only abilities have 1 0 0, auras 1 1 0, hexes 0 0 1)
_fields.effects: special_ability_phase_stat_effects of the phases: stat, how (add or mult), value, and on whom (the phase's targets)
_fields.attributes: special_ability_phase_attribute_effects of the phases (attribute, attribute_type: positive/negative)
_fields.heal: only an ability whose phases heal (special_ability_phases heal_amount != 0: Regeneration): share - heal_amount, the share of the unit's largest health healed each tick; every_s - hp_change_frequency, the tick, s (Regeneration 0.001 every 1.0 s: the Brood Horror's 6009 HP heal 6 HP/s - the game's program, build/diag_skv_mon/mechanic.md M11: round(heal_amount x the power x the largest health) a tick)
_fields.direct: only an ability whose phase deals direct damage (special_ability_phases damage_amount != 0: the Pusbags' Unshakable Pathogen): amount - damage_amount, entities - max_damaged_entities (-1: all its men), every_s - hp_change_frequency (the tick: at the phase's start and every every_s), on - the phase's targets, scale - _kv_unit_ability_scaling_rules direct_damage_<UNIT_SIZE> (ultra 1.0), min_unary - direct_damage_damage_scale_min_unary (0.5): a tick strikes min(entities, alive) different random men, each trunc(trunc(max(1, amount x scale)) x U[min_unary, 1]), at least 1 HP, past armour and shields (the game's program, build/diag_roster/wh3_dlc29_skv_inf_pusbags/mechanic.md B1-B4); hit_hp - the mean of that (3.2), hit_dist - [[HP, share]]; magical - the hit is magical (past armour and shields, the spell resistance and the ward cut it: round(HP x (100 - resistance) / 100), the physical does not); range_m - effect_range (0: the owner itself), hold_m - range_m + DIRECT_HOLD_M 5 (a target stays one to there), n_enemy / n_friend - num_effected_enemy_units / _friendly_units (-1 all), every_frame - update_targets_every_frame (the targets re-picked every tick, one out of range dropped at once, back in: a tick at once), duration_s - the phase's duration, else the ability's active_time (-1: while on); the random men are picked again at every tick (build/diag_roster/wh2_dlc14_skv_inf_warp_grinder_0/mechanic.md W2-W5, 5)
_fields.behaviour: unit_special_abilities.behaviour when set (vortex_on_entity_death: a vortex at every man's death; such an ability without a recharge is passive whatever its active time)
_fields.vortex: battle_vortexs of unit_special_abilities.vortex: delay_s - delay (+ i x between_s for the i-th of n - num_vortexes / delay_between_vortexes), duration_s - max(duration, goal_radius / expansion_speed), start_radius_m / goal_radius_m / expansion_speed - the circle growing, damage / damage_ap - one strike of a man (at most once a second a vortex: once in its 1 s), magical - is_magical (the physical resistance off), spell - is_spell (the spell resistance on), flaming - ignition_amount != 0, force - detonation_force (the knock: dv = 1.3 F S / (F + m), S the expansion speed), contact - contact_effect (laid on the whole unit of a man struck), allies / enemies - affects_allies / affects_enemies, move_m_s - movement_speed, launch - launch_source, follow - follow_target, next - subsequent_vortex (mechanic.md P1-P8)
_fields.delay_s: only a passive of several phases whose first phases lay nothing (Blackpowder Discipline: phase i 10 s, no stats, then phase ii): the special_ability_phases durations of those first phases, in the junctions' order - its effects come on once its conditions have held that long (ours: the phases run in order)

_missing.area damage: battle_vortexs decoded since 31.10.2026 (the passport's `vortex`); the simulator acts on the vortex at a man's death only (tools/nn/sim/vortex.py). Verminous Valour's vortex (25 m, 1 s, damage 0, force 200) throws the men around the Warlord back: probe T-E3, 2 s after the cast no swordsman within 6 m, the nearest 6.5-8.6 m away, in contact again after ~8 s - no knockback of an active ability's vortex in the simulator
_missing.conditions: decoded: recharge_when (special_ability_to_recharge_contexts) and off_when (special_ability_to_auto_deactivate_flags); a passive's effects are what it gives while on; passive and auto abilities are innate effects (config/nn/effects.json, python -m tools.nn.effects)
_missing.ui type: unit_abilities (hex, augment, ...) is not decoded: the targets say the same

_spell_fields.mana: unit_special_abilities.mana_cost: the winds of magic a cast takes from its side's current pool
_spell_fields.wind_up_s: unit_special_abilities.wind_up_time, s: the caster stands casting this long after the order
_spell_fields.range_m: unit_special_abilities.target_intercept_range, m: the cast's reach, caster's centre to the target's (out of it the caster walks in first: the magic probe, build/magic/probe1.md)
_spell_fields.active_s: unit_special_abilities.active_time, s; the recharge runs from its end (the probe: casts 40 s / 37 s apart = wind-up + active + recharge)
_spell_fields.initial_s: unit_special_abilities.initial_recharge, s (-1 and 0: ready at once)
_spell_fields.ai_usage: unit_special_abilities.ai_usage: the game's AI usage template
_spell_fields.overcast: unit_abilities.overpower_option: the overcast spell's key (not modelled yet)
_spell_fields.bombardment: projectile_bombardments of unit_special_abilities.bombardment: projectiles = num_projectiles, start_s = start_time (after the wind-up), window_s = arrival_window, spread_m = radius_spread (the projectiles land within this radius of the aim), launch_height_m = launch_height, launch = launch_source
_spell_fields.bombardment.projectile: projectiles of its projectile_type: damage, ap = ap_damage, collision_m = collision_radius, penetration = projectile_penetration_junctions.max_penetration of its projectile_penetration (the men one projectile can strike), penetration_cap = its entity_size_cap, elevation_deg = fixed_elevation, muzzle_v = muzzle_velocity, gravity, magical = is_magical, allies = can_damage_allies, explosion = explosion_type, mass (its knock on the man it strikes: mass x impact_v / his mass against the game's collision_speed_delta_threshold_knocked_*), impact_v = ours: its speed at the end of the fall (flight_s)
_spell_fields.bombardment.explosion: projectiles_explosions of the projectile's explosion_type: radius_m = detonation_radius, damage = detonation_damage, ap = detonation_damage_ap, allies = affects_allies, force = detonation_force (its shockwave's knock: force / a man's mass against shockwave_speed_delta_threshold_knocked_*)
_spell_fields.bombardment.flight_s: ours: the fall from launch_height at muzzle_velocity aimed fixed_elevation below the horizontal under gravity, h = v sin(e) t + g t^2 / 2 (Searing Doom 2.96 s, Warp Lightning 1.17 s: with the wind-up and start the first hit 5.96 / 5.17 s after the order, the probe 6.0 / 5.0-5.5 s)
